verdict.rationale: Railway documents an official MCP server at docs.railway.com/ai/mcp-server. It lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables and redeploy services, and the CLI configures MCP, skills and authentication in one command. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described, and a detailed tool/auth reference beyond the summary-level doc snippets.
